title: Gospel justifies every living believer by grace—Crede et servaberis, not Fac et vives
source_text: XXXIV. Sed ab omnibus, a quibus non possumus per legem Mosis justificari, per Christum omnis qui credit justificabitur. Nam Deus in Evangelio promittit se, propter Christum, credentes omnes in gratiam recepturum, & liberationem a maledictione legis, ac remissionem peccatorum omnium, in Christi sanguine, offert omnibus indiscriminatim, qui Christum fide viva, & per dilectionem operante, amplexi fuerint; illisque tanquam justis vitam & gloriam aeternam pollicetur. Ideoque Evangelium ad justificationem maximos etiam peccatores admittit, modo peccatis suis renunciantes, & edentes fructus poenitentia dignos, in Christum fide viva & efficaci credant. Nec enim justificat ex debito, sed ex gratia. Nec dicit, Fac & vives, verum, Crede & servaberis.
pass_a_gloss: But from all those by whom we cannot be justified through Moses' law, through Christ everyone who believes will be justified. For God in the Gospel promises that for Christ's sake he will receive all believers into grace, and offers liberation from the law's curse and remission of all sins in Christ's blood indiscriminately to all who have embraced Christ with living faith working through love; and to them as to the just he promises eternal life and glory. Therefore the Gospel admits even the greatest sinners to justification, provided that renouncing their sins and bearing fruits worthy of repentance they believe in Christ with living and efficacious faith. For it does not justify from debt but from grace. Nor does it say, Do this and you shall live, but Believe and you will be saved.
pass_b_english: Gospel justifies every living love-working believer by grace—even great sinners who repent.
Not Fac et vives but Crede et servaberis.

lemmas.gloss: Believe and you will be saved

choices.why: Gospel offer to all living believers.
